description: This file defines a custom exception class 'JsonTypeNotParsableException' used in the project for error handling related to unsupported JSON types during parsing. It includes mechanisms for creating instances with various parameters and a builder class for flexible construction. The class is part of the package related to signals handling in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JsonTypeNotParsableException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing errors when a JSON type cannot be parsed. It extends DittoRuntimeException and provides static methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects. Annotated as immutable and JSON-parsable with an associated error code.

classes.name: JsonTypeNotParsableException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of JsonTypeNotParsableException with a fluent API. It is not thread-safe and provides methods to set message, description, cause, and href before building the exception.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a JsonTypeNotParsableException, initialized with the unsupported type and registry name.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a new JsonTypeNotParsableException with a custom message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new JsonTypeNotParsableException from a JSON object representing the error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified DittoHeaders, preserving other details.
